theme.emotional_tone: Playful, Tactile, Assertive, Raw but Accessible
theme.concept: Rejects boring, sterile productivity apps. Uses hard black borders, deep shadows, and clashing pastels to make checking off tasks feel like an energetic, tactile game.

patterns.empty_states: Large uncropped 3D/abstract image (max-h-[30vh]), oversized h3 heading, raw pastel background blob, crisp CTA button.
patterns.share_modal: Centered popup. Background overlay: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm. Modal container: bg-[#FDE68A] border-4 border-[#0A0A0A] shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#0A0A0A] p-8 max-w-[90vw] mx-auto
patterns.profile_code_display: Massive typography (h1) inside a high-contrast container. e.g., bg-[#A7F3D0] border-4 border-[#0A0A0A] p-6 sm:p-8 text-center shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#0A0A0A]
patterns.notifications_feed: Stack of simple border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] items with color-coded background tags indicating type (e.g., bg-[#A7F3D0] for 'Task Completed', bg-[#FECDD3] for 'Task Shared').

login_hero.description: Abstract colorful geometric backdrop for the auth screen

empty_state_todos.description: Minimalist desk elements for the 'No Todos' state

empty_state_notifications.description: Sleeping cat for the 'No Notifications' sleeping empty state

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text and interactive borders meet APCA standards. Black #0A0A0A ensures maximum legibility against pastel surfaces.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid. Examples: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='todo-item-card', data-testid='todo-checkbox', data-testid='share-submit-button', data-testid='nav-my-todos', data-testid='empty-state-container'

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use soft shadows or rounded cards. Strictly adhere to the neo-brutalist shadow classes provided (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]).
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is used for headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Fallback to standard geometric sans-serifs if missing.
Implement the custom checkbox with the exact styles provided in 'components.inputs.checkbox'. No default blue checkboxes.
Use Phosphor Icons (bold or fill variants) to match the heavy neo-brutalist aesthetic.
Ensure mobile tap targets are large (min-h-[48px]). All buttons, tabs, and inputs must respect this ergonomic rule.
For image attachments inside To-Do cards, add a 2px black border around the thumbnail image. No plain floating images.
Apply `data-testid` to EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards) and significant static elements (empty states).
The sharing modal should feel like a physical card dropped on top of the UI. Use the 'share_modal' pattern specs.
Never use purely centered everything. Add tension by left-aligning massive headings and mixing them with asymmetrical floating images.
Ensure the .js components use these precise Tailwind utility classes. Do not convert them to .tsx as requested by the user.
